result.description: Looking for IT Support Fresher - Brendale - North Brisbane   NOTE:  Candidate who have 3+ years of experience are not eligible to apply for this role.   Your New Company:  Our client is a successful family-owned advertising company operating within the promotional products industry. With a workforce of approximately 200-300 employees, the organisation combines international product sourcing with local production and decoration services. The business values responsive internal support and relies on a stable IT environment to keep both office and production operations running efficiently.   Your New Role:  As an IT Support Officer, you will serve as the first point of contact for internal staff, providing day-to-day technical support across the organisation. Working closely with the IT team, you will troubleshoot hardware, software, and access-related issues while ensuring users receive timely and effective support. Providing first-line IT support for hardware, software, and system access issues. Supporting users across a large onsite production facility and remote staff. Managing user onboarding, account administration, and offboarding activities. Administering Microsoft 365 licences and Active Directory user accounts. Supporting Windows-based domain environments and Microsoft 365 applications. Assisting with specialised production systems and coordinating vendor escalations when required. Utilising remote support and monitoring tools such as TeamViewer and Pulseway. Maintaining IT documentation and contributing to continuous improvement of support processes.   What you will need to succeed:  Previous experience in an IT Support, Help Desk, or Service Desk position. Solid knowledge of Microsoft Windows operating systems and Microsoft 365. Basic Active Directory administration experience, including user management and permissions. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and customer service capabilities. Experience supporting users in a hands-on onsite environment. The ability to work effectively within a small collaborative IT team. A proactive, solutions-focused attitude and willingness to learn new technologies. Exposure to remote support tools and monitoring platforms will be highly regarded.   What you will get in return:  Permanent full-time opportunity with a stable and growing organisation. Work within a supportive and collaborative IT team. Exposure to a broad range of technologies and production environments. Opportunities to develop your technical skills and career. Convenient North Brisbane location. Competitive salary package and long-term career prospects. result.description: DKS ASSOCIATES PTY LTD  We're looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Construction Estimator to join DKS Associates Pty Ltd, trading as Carports Factory Outlet.   Working on a diverse range of residential and commercial projects, you'll play a key role in preparing accurate cost estimates, quotations, and project budgets for custom-built steel carports and outdoor structures. You will work closely with customers, suppliers, and installation contractors to ensure projects are delivered efficiently, on budget and to the highest quality standards.   From interpreting architectural and engineering drawings to analysing project costs and coordinating procurement activities, you'll contribute to the commercial success of the business while working in a supportive and collaborative environment. This is an excellent opportunity to develop your career with a growing Australian business in the steel structures and outdoor construction sector.   The successful applicant will have strong construction estimating experience, excellent analytical and communication skills, and the ability to accurately interpret technical drawings and specifications. Experience in residential or light structural construction, including steel carports or outdoor structures, will be highly regarded.   Benefits  The position offers a competitive salary package of AUD $79,500 – $84,000 per annum plus superannuation, ongoing professional development opportunities, career progression and a supportive team environment.   • Full-time, permanent position (38 hours per week)  • Opportunity for career growth and professional development   • Supportive and collaborative team environment   • Work on a diverse range of residential and commercial steel structure projects   • Stable employment with a growing Australian business   Task & responsibilities  • Prepare accurate cost estimates, quotations, and project budgets based on client requirements, drawings, and specifications   • Interpret architectural, engineering, and construction drawings to determine project scope and material requirements   • Calculate material quantities, labour costs, equipment, and overheads for residential and commercial steel structure projects   • Obtain, review, and negotiate supplier and installation contractor quotations to achieve competitive pricing   • Liaise directly with customers to clarify requirements, refine quotations, and provide technical guidance on product selection and compliance   • Prepare pricing schedules and supporting project documentation   • Monitor project costs and analyse variations between estimated and actual costs   • Ensure all estimating activities comply with relevant Australian building codes, AS/NZS 1170 wind rating standards, and industry regulations   • Maintain and update pricing databases, cost-monitoring systems, and quotation records   • Identify cost-saving opportunities while maintaining quality and compliance standards   • Maintain accurate estimating records, project documentation, and cost databases   • Assist with procurement planning and material scheduling to support project timelines   • Contribute to continuous improvement of estimating processes and commercial performance.      Qualification & experience  • Diploma or higher qualification in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Building, or a related discipline   • Minimum 2–3 years of experience as a Construction Estimator or in a similar estimating role   • Strong knowledge of Australian construction methods, materials, and estimating practices   • Experience interpreting architectural, engineering, and structural drawings   • Proficiency in estimating software, Microsoft Excel, and project management tools   • Excellent analytical, numerical, and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail   • Ability to manage multiple quotations and deadlines in a fast-paced environment   • Strong communication and customer management skills   • Knowledge of Australian building codes, AS/NZS 1170 regulations, and WHS requirements   • Experience in residential, commercial, or light steel construction projects is highly regarded  About Company    DKS Associates Pty Ltd (ABN 15 679 249 757), trading as Carports Factory Outlet, is a growing Australian business specialising in the design, supply, and installation of custom steel carports and outdoor structures for residential and commercial clients. Based in Sunshine North, Victoria, with an additional warehouse in Caboolture, Queensland, we provide cost-effective, durable steel structure solutions while maintaining the highest standards of quality, safety, and customer service. Our collaborative workplace offers employees the opportunity to develop their skills and build long-term careers within Australia's construction and steel structures industry.
